item.title: Avalanche leaves 2 ski patrollers injured at Mammoth Mountain
item.description: Two ski patrollers were injured in an avalanche at Mammoth Mountain Friday morning while they were performing mitigation work.

item.title: Sierra Nevada gets fresh blanket of snow; travelers warned to be aware of road conditions
item.description: The Sierra Nevada is covered in fresh snow for the holiday week, but with the reward comes risks. What had been dirt is now covered by a blanket of fresh snow, bringing with it dangerous roads.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Cool, clear start to the weekend
item.description: It's a cool start to the weekend with more rain on the way to start the new year.

item.title: PG&E's $200 credit 'doesn't cut it' as some SF residents continue to recover after power outage
item.description: PG&E is offering $200 bill credits to residents impacted by the outage and up to $2,500 for businesses that lost inventory or revenue. But many in the community say that doesn't come close to covering their losses.

item.title: Multi-million dollar donation saves iconic San Francisco drag cabaret
item.description: After months of mourning its impending closure, there was a celebration Friday night at San Francisco's Oasis drag cabaret in the wake of a multi-million dollar donation to keep the doors open.

item.title: Nigerian villagers are rattled by US airstrikes that made their homes shake and the sky glow red
item.description: The residents witnessed the sky glowing red from the attack late on Thursday night. U.S. President Donald Trump announced the strike.

item.title: California drops lawsuit seeking to reinstate federal funding for the state's bullet train
item.description: California this week dropped a lawsuit officials filed against the Trump administration over the federal government's withdrawing of $4 billion for the state's long-delayed high-speed rail project.

item.title: Russia strikes Ukraine's capital, kills at least 1 person day before Zelenskyy-Trump meeting
item.description: Russia attacked Ukraine's capital with ballistic missiles and drones on Saturday, killing at least one person and wounding 27, a day before talks between the leaders of Ukraine and the United States, authorities said.

item.title: SF Tenderloin grant program offers small businesses opportunities to move into vacant spaces
item.description: In San Francisco, several new businesses are moving into vacant storefronts in the Tenderloin. It's part of a grant program that provides money for rent and renovations.

item.title: Firefighters reopen roads after gas leak in South San Jose prompts temporary closures
item.description: Firefighters have cleared the area after responding to a gas leak near the intersection of Cottle Road and Santa Teresa Boulevard on Saturday, which prompted road closures.
